name: repo-hygiene
description: Pre-PR checklist and repo cleanup for data-science / analytics projects. Catches mistakes that cost hours later: data files committed to git (.csv/.db/.parquet), hardcoded /Users/ paths, tracked runtime artifacts, branch-ownership confusion, internal docs drifting from deliverables, and client data in public repos. The project-quality track's 'clean' tool — sibling to test-effectiveness-auditor (which measures the same repo's tests). Use before gh pr create, before merging, or at handover.
